newsitem.title: USA: California budget talks delayed - officials.
newsitem.headline: California budget talks delayed - officials.

text.p: California's governor and legislative leaders called off budget talks scheduled for Thursday, state officials said.

Gov. Pete Wilson and leaders of the state Senate and Assembly, known collectively as the "Big Five," cancelled the talks to give the legislature's budget conference committee more time to negotiate a compromise, officials said.
The conference committee -- made up of three senators and three assembly members -- has been holding daily hearings.
The committee's goal is to meld the budget packages of the state Assembly and Senate into a single spending plan for the fiscal year that begins July 1.
